`graph-run` is present in the `## Workflow sequence` diagram, carrying both edges the two `prepare` edges used to carry.
The `thejudge-prepare` catalog `When` cell no longer describes an intake route, and the row is still present.
`Three `graph-*` skills` matches in AGENT-SKILLS.md and the count of `Two `graph-*` skills` is 0.
This slice's `git diff --name-only` lists exactly AGENT-SKILLS.md and graph-workflow-contract.md; prepare's skill and contract are untouched.
`grep -rn "thejudge-prepare is controlling" .claude/skills/` still returns the same six phase skills as before the slice.
